DCC / DCCL: Cortech Cobra Can Dolly
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-cobra-trash-can-dolly
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/facilities-maintenance/cobra-can/
Spec sheets: Cobra Can Flame Retardant, Cobra Can Food Grade and General Use
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Cobra Can Dolly – DCC / DCCL
Current H1: Cortech Cobra Trash Can Dolly
Subtitle: Rolling Dolly for Cortech Cobra Cans, in Two Sizes for 20 to 30 or 35 to 55 Gallon Cans
Current subtitle: Cortech USA DCC, DCCL Cobra Can Dolly for Trash Cans
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Cobra Can Dolly puts a Cortech Cobra Can (sold separately) on casters, so full trash cans can be rolled instead of dragged or carried. It comes in two sizes: the DCC for 20 to 30 gallon cans and the DCCL for 35 to 55 gallon cans.
The dolly works with both the flame retardant and the food grade and general use Cobra Cans.
Fit: Made for Cortech Cobra Cans, flame retardant or food grade and general use
Sizes: DCC for 20 to 30 gallon cans; DCCL for 35 to 55 gallon cans
Casters: Rolling casters
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
DCC – 20 to 30 Gallon: For 20, 22, 25, and 30 gallon Cobra Cans
DCCL – 35 to 55 Gallon: For 35, 40, 45, 50, and 55 gallon Cobra Cans
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The Cobra Can Dolly suits facilities that move full trash cans every day.
Typical applications include:
Housing units, dayrooms, and common areas in correctional facilities and jails
Kitchens, dining halls, and food service areas
Behavioral healthcare facilities and other high-abuse settings
Explore Anchortex's Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collections for more trash receptacles and sanitation supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Facilities Maintenance
Cortech facilities maintenance products are molded to stand up to hard daily use in correctional facilities, behavioral healthcare facilities, and other high-abuse settings.
Cortech facilities maintenance includes:
Trash Receptacles: Cobra Cans in 20 to 55 gallon sizes, in flame retardant or food grade and general use material, and Cobra Mini Cans in 10 and 14 quart sizes
Can Dollies: Cobra Can dollies in two sizes
Carts: Kangaroo Carts and lids for laundry, trash, and material handling
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description

Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Facilities Maintenance" is a new section for the Cobra Can, Cobra Mini Can, can dolly, and Kangaroo Cart pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
Worksheet: on your worksheet, the DCC row (Row # 295) is marked "group 5," but the DCCL row (Row # 296) is marked "skip." I documented both sizes, since they are on the same page. Is that okay, or should the DCCL be left out?
Details: the Cortech spec sheets list only the two dolly model numbers and sizes. They give no weight, size, material, or warranty for the dolly, so I kept the description short. The "rolling casters" comes from your current page.
Weight: your variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. Can you get the dolly weights from Cortech?
H1: Cortech calls it the Cobra Can Dolly, so I used that and added the model numbers.
Collection links: the dolly is in your Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Kitchen and Food Service collections, so I linked those two.
Product images: the page has one image (DCC). The Cortech Cobra Can page has one dolly photo. Would you like me to add it?
